title: Second Opinion chord label (PRD 8)
description: One labelled clip. Beats count from the downbeat (beat 0 = bar 1, beat 1). Symbols use the Second Opinion vocabulary (maj, m, dim, aug, sus2, sus4, 6, m6, 7, maj7, m7, m7b5, dim7, add9, 9, maj9, m9, 7sus4) with an optional /bass, or N for no chord. Checked by tools/eval/eval_chords.py.

audio.description: WAV file name, relative to the label file

downbeat_sec.description: time of beat 0 in the audio
